_about: Trend library for step 11 (tech-trend-analysis). Adoption levels are the library's last reviewed view, not verified facts: each trend used in a run is either verified with web/fetch (sources recorded) or marked unverified. Keys are permanent.

entries.title: Passkeys replacing passwords
entries.description: Sign-in with device-bound WebAuthn credentials, supported by the major platforms.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Share of consumer services offering passkeys

entries.title: SMS one-time codes as the only second factor
entries.description: SMS codes are vulnerable to SIM swap and phishing; services are moving to app, passkey or push factors.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Regulator and standards guidance on SMS OTP

entries.title: Invisible bot protection instead of visual CAPTCHAs
entries.description: Risk-based, mostly invisible checks replace puzzles that block real users and fail accessibility.

entries.title: LLM assistants inside products
entries.description: Products embed chat or copilot features built on large language models with tool access.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Typical cost and accuracy of current models

entries.title: Retrieval-augmented search
entries.description: Answers grounded in the product's own content, retrieved from a vector or hybrid index.

entries.title: Voice AI agents for phone calls
entries.description: AI agents answer phone calls and complete simple tasks such as booking.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Accuracy and consumer acceptance of voice agents

entries.title: AI clinical documentation scribes
entries.description: Ambient AI drafts clinical notes from the consultation for clinician review.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Regulatory status in the target country

entries.title: Online self-scheduling
entries.description: Customers expect to book, move and cancel appointments online at any hour.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Share of bookings made online in the sector

entries.title: Two-way SMS appointment reminders
entries.description: Reminders customers can confirm or cancel by reply; widely used to cut no-shows.

entries.title: Business messaging on WhatsApp and similar apps
entries.description: Customers are reached on chat apps they already use, with templates and opt-in.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Regional adoption and pricing of business messaging

entries.title: Mobile wallet passes
entries.description: Tickets, bookings and cards stored in Apple or Google Wallet with live updates.

entries.title: Embedded payments
entries.description: Software products take payments natively instead of sending users elsewhere.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Provider fees and availability by country

entries.title: Open banking APIs
entries.description: Account data and payments through regulated bank APIs.

entries.title: Real-time payment rails
entries.description: Account-to-account payments that settle in seconds.

entries.title: FHIR-based health data exchange
entries.description: Health systems expose and exchange records with the HL7 FHIR standard, often by regulation.

entries.title: Telehealth visits
entries.description: Video consultations are an established channel alongside in-person care.

entries.title: Accessibility laws for digital services
entries.description: Laws increasingly require WCAG-level accessibility for consumer-facing digital services.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Which laws apply to the client and from when

entries.title: Privacy-first product analytics
entries.description: Analytics without third-party cookies, with consent and data minimisation by design.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Consent rules for analytics in the target country

entries.title: Core Web Vitals as the performance yardstick
entries.description: LCP, INP and CLS measured on real users are the common way to set web performance targets.

entries.title: Installable progressive web apps
entries.description: Web apps with offline support and home-screen install instead of separate native apps.
entries.time_sensitive_claim: Platform support for web push and install

entries.title: Edge rendering and caching
entries.description: Pages rendered or cached at the network edge close to users.

entries.title: OpenTelemetry observability
entries.description: A vendor-neutral standard for traces, metrics and logs.

entries.title: Feature flags and progressive delivery
entries.description: Release features gradually and turn them off without redeploying.

entries.title: Event-driven integration with webhooks
entries.description: Systems integrate by publishing events and webhooks instead of polling.

entries.title: Zero-trust access
entries.description: Every request is authenticated and authorised; no trusted internal network.

entries.title: Composable, API-first products
entries.description: Products assembled from replaceable API-first services.

entries.title: Headless commerce
entries.description: Storefront decoupled from the commerce engine through APIs.

entries.title: Low-code internal tools
entries.description: Back-office screens built with low-code platforms instead of custom code.

entries.title: Local-first apps with sync
entries.description: Data lives on the device first and syncs with conflict-free data types.

entries.title: Digital identity wallets
entries.description: Government-backed digital ID wallets for sign-in and verified attributes.

entries.title: Carbon-aware software
entries.description: Choosing regions and timing to reduce the carbon footprint of computing.

entries.title: Microlearning
entries.description: Short, focused learning units delivered in the flow of work.

entries.title: Edge analytics for IoT
entries.description: Processing sensor data on or near devices before sending it to the cloud.

entries.title: AI agents for back-office tasks
entries.description: Agents that carry out multi-step tasks under human approval.
